requirements.summary: Implement role-based UI rendering and user profile setup flow with authentication
acceptanceCriteria: Users can register and login with role assignment
Citizen role has access to reporting and tracking features
Authority role can review and update complaint status
Admin role has full system access including user management
Role-based UI components render based on authenticated user role

file_operations.description: Create custom hook to fetch current user profile using authorization component's getCallerUserProfile backend method. Use the authorization component to support role-based access control. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing. Handle actor dependency properly to prevent modal flash as per authorization component guidelines.

Create custom hook for saving user profile using authorization component's saveCallerUserProfile backend method. Use the authorization component to support role-based access control. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create custom hook to fetch current user role using the authorization component's getCallerUserRole backend method. Use the authorization component to support role-based access control. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create login/logout button component following authorization component patterns. Use the authorization component to support authentication. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing. Handle query cache clearing on logout.

Create modal for first-time user profile setup collecting name and role assignment. Show only when user is authenticated, actor is ready, profile query is complete, and profile is null. Use the authorization component to support role-based access control. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create component to conditionally render children based on user role (Citizen, Authority, Admin). Use the authorization component to support role-based access control. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create screen component for unauthorized access attempts with helpful messaging and login prompt.

requirements.summary: Create image upload UI with automatic location and timestamp capture for civic issue reporting
acceptanceCriteria: Users can upload images when creating a report
Location coordinates are automatically captured and attached to the report
Timestamp is automatically recorded when image is captured
Support for multiple issue categories: tobacco spit, garbage, traffic violations, public nuisance
Images are stored securely in the backend

file_operations.description: Create image upload component with file input, preview, and location capture. Use the blob-storage component to support file upload with ExternalBlob.fromBytes() and progress tracking via withUploadProgress(). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing. Capture browser geolocation coordinates and current timestamp. Display upload progress percentage.

Create hook for uploading media using uploadMedia backend method. Use the blob-storage component to support file operations with ExternalBlob class. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing. Handle image file conversion to ExternalBlob and URL generation.
Create hook to capture browser geolocation coordinates using navigator.geolocation API. Return latitude, longitude, loading state, and error state.
Define frontend types for Media, MediaType, and upload-related state management mirroring backend interface types.

requirements.summary: Implement video upload UI with duration validation and automatic location/timestamp tagging
acceptanceCriteria: Users can upload videos between 30-90 seconds in length
Video upload validates duration constraints
Location and timestamp are automatically tagged to video reports
Videos are stored securely in the backend
Video file size is managed appropriately for web delivery

file_operations.description: Create video upload component with file input, duration validation (30-90 seconds), preview player, and location capture. Use the blob-storage component to support video file upload with ExternalBlob.fromBytes() and progress tracking. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing. Display video duration and upload progress. Show validation errors for invalid durations.
Create utility functions to validate video duration (30-90 seconds) and check file size constraints. Extract video metadata using HTML5 video element.

requirements.summary: Implement one-tap helpline integration UI with emergency contacts and city-based municipal detection
acceptanceCriteria: Users can access quick dial buttons for 112, 1969, and 103
System detects user's city based on location
Municipal helpline contact is automatically displayed for detected city
Helpline buttons are prominently displayed and easily accessible
UI clearly labels each helpline with its purpose

file_operations.description: Create helpline panel displaying prominent buttons for 112 (Emergency), 1969 (Traffic Police), and 103 (Ambulance). Show detected city name and municipal contact. Use tel: links for contact display (not actual calling). Style buttons with clear icons and purpose labels.
Create hook to detect user's city from geolocation coordinates. Use reverse geocoding logic or coordinate-based city mapping. Return city name and municipal contact info.
Define static data structure mapping cities to municipal helpline contacts for display purposes.

requirements.summary: Create complaint status tracking UI showing current status and history timeline
acceptanceCriteria: Each complaint has a status field that can be one of: Received, Under Review, Action Taken, Escalated
Citizens can view the current status of their submitted complaints
Authority users can update complaint status
Status change history is tracked with timestamps
Users receive visual indication of status changes

file_operations.description: Create status badge component displaying complaint status (Received, Under Review, Action Taken, Escalated) with color-coded styling for dark theme.
Create timeline component displaying complaint status history with timestamps. Show visual progression through status states.
Create status update component for Authority users with dropdown to change complaint status. Use RoleGuard to restrict to Authority and Admin roles. Call updateComplaintStatus backend method.
Create mutation hook for updating complaint status using updateComplaintStatus backend method. Invalidate complaint queries on success.

requirements.summary: Implement anonymous reporting toggle and tracking ID display
acceptanceCriteria: Users can toggle anonymous mode when creating a report
Anonymous reports do not display reporter identity to authorities
Anonymous reporters receive a unique tracking ID to check report status
System maintains report integrity without storing personal identifiers for anonymous reports
Anonymous option is clearly presented in the reporting UI

file_operations.description: Create toggle switch component for anonymous reporting option with explanatory text. Display in report creation form.
Create component to display complaint tracking ID with copy-to-clipboard functionality. Show prominently after anonymous report submission.

requirements.summary: Build real-time civic heatmap dashboard displaying geographic distribution of reported issues
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays a map view of the city with heatmap overlay
Heatmap color intensity reflects the density of civic issues in each area
Map updates in real-time or near real-time as new reports are submitted
Users can filter heatmap by issue type
Heatmap is visually clear and accessible on mobile devices

file_operations.description: Create heatmap visualization component displaying complaint density by geographic area. Use grid-based or zone-based approach without external mapping services. Color-code by density (low to high). Include issue type filter controls.
Create query hook to fetch complaints by status using getComplaintsByStatus backend method. Enable filtering and real-time updates via polling or refetch intervals.
Create utility functions to calculate complaint density by geographic grid or zone. Group complaints by location coordinates and compute density scores.

requirements.summary: Implement area-wise civic score calculation and display system
acceptanceCriteria: System calculates civic scores for geographic areas (neighborhoods, districts)
Score calculation incorporates cleanliness metrics based on garbage and tobacco spit reports
Score calculation incorporates discipline metrics based on traffic violations and public nuisance reports
Scores are normalized and displayed as easy-to-understand ratings
Area scores are updated periodically as new reports are processed

file_operations.description: Create component displaying civic scores by area with cleanliness and discipline indices. Show scores as ratings (stars or numeric). Group by geographic zones.

Create utility functions to calculate area civic scores from complaint data. Compute cleanliness score from garbage and tobacco spit reports. Compute discipline score from traffic and nuisance reports. Normalize to 0-100 scale.

requirements.summary: Create gamified civic score system with badges and leaderboards
acceptanceCriteria: Users earn civic score points for submitting valid reports
System awards badges for milestones (first report, 10 reports, 50 reports, etc.)
City-level leaderboard displays top contributors with their scores
School-level leaderboard is available for student users
Leaderboards and badges are displayed in user profiles
Gamification elements use simple, encouraging language

file_operations.description: Create component displaying user badges with earned badge icons. Reference generated badge images: frontend/public/assets/generated/badge-first-report.dim_200x200.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/badge-champion.dim_200x200.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/badge-leader.dim_200x200.png. Show locked/unlocked state for milestone badges.
Create component displaying user's civic score from UserProfile.civicScore with visual progress indicators.
Create leaderboard component showing top contributors with names and scores. Support city-level and school-level views with tab switching.
Create utility functions to determine earned badges based on user report count and civic score. Define badge milestone thresholds.

requirements.summary: Build volunteer and NGO task marketplace UI for task posting and browsing
acceptanceCriteria: NGO and organization accounts can create and post civic tasks
Tasks include description, location, required volunteers, and time commitment
Volunteers can browse available tasks and express interest or commit
Task status tracking shows open, in-progress, and completed tasks
Volunteers receive recognition in their profiles for completed tasks

file_operations.description: Create task listing component displaying available volunteer tasks with filters for status (open, in-progress, completed). Show task details: description, location, volunteers needed, time commitment.
Create task card component displaying individual task with action buttons for volunteers to express interest or commit. Show task status badge.
Create form for NGOs and organizations to post new tasks. Use RoleGuard to restrict to authorized roles. Include fields for description, location, volunteer count, and time commitment.
Create component displaying user's completed volunteer tasks in their profile for recognition.

requirements.summary: Create RTI draft auto-generator UI for creating formatted RTI requests
acceptanceCriteria: Users can select a complaint to generate an RTI draft
System generates RTI document with proper legal format and language
RTI draft includes complaint details, questions for authorities, and user information
Generated RTI is available in both Hindi and English
Users can download or copy the RTI draft for submission

file_operations.description: Create RTI generator component allowing users to select a complaint and generate formatted RTI draft. Display generated document with copy and download buttons. Support Hindi and English language output.
Define RTI document templates in Hindi and English with placeholders for complaint details, user info, and questions for authorities.
Create utility functions to populate RTI templates with complaint data and generate formatted text output for download.

requirements.summary: Build before/after impact proof generator with image comparison
acceptanceCriteria: Users can upload 'after' images for resolved complaints
System displays side-by-side comparison of before and after images
Impact proof includes timestamps for both images
Generated proof can be shared or downloaded
Visual comparison clearly demonstrates the improvement

file_operations.description: Create before/after image comparison component displaying original complaint images alongside uploaded resolution images. Show timestamps for both. Include download button for comparison view.

Create component for uploading 'after' resolution images for resolved complaints. Use the blob-storage component to support image upload. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing. Link to original complaint.

requirements.summary: Implement multi-language support for Hindi and English throughout the application
acceptanceCriteria: Users can switch between Hindi and English in app settings
All UI labels, buttons, and messages display in selected language
Complaint documents and RTI drafts are generated in selected language
Language preference persists across sessions
Text uses simple, easy-to-understand vocabulary in both languages

file_operations.description: Create language context providing current language state (Hindi/English) and toggle function. Persist language preference to localStorage.
Create translation hook providing t() function for looking up translations by key in current language.
Define English translations for all UI text, labels, buttons, messages, and content. Use simple, clear vocabulary.
Define Hindi translations for all UI text, labels, buttons, messages, and content. Use simple, clear vocabulary.
Create language toggle component allowing users to switch between Hindi and English. Display current language and toggle button.

requirements.summary: Create daily civic quiz feature with 5 multiple-choice questions
acceptanceCriteria: New quiz with 5 questions is available each day
Questions cover topics like cleanliness, traffic rules, public behavior, environmental responsibility
Questions use simple language appropriate for all education levels
Users receive immediate feedback on their answers
Quiz score out of 5 is displayed after completion
Quiz history and scores are tracked in user profile

file_operations.description: Create daily quiz component displaying 5 multiple-choice questions about civic responsibility. Show immediate feedback on answer selection. Display final score out of 5. Rotate daily based on date.

Define pool of civic quiz questions covering cleanliness, traffic rules, public behavior, and environmental topics in both Hindi and English. Each question includes 4 options and correct answer. Use simple language.
Create component displaying user's quiz history with dates and scores in their profile.
Create utility functions to select daily quiz questions based on current date. Use deterministic selection to ensure same questions for all users on same day.

requirements.summary: Implement daily civic fact feature with educational content rotation
acceptanceCriteria: A new civic fact is displayed each day on the home screen or dedicated section
Facts are written in simple, accessible language
Facts cover topics like waste management, traffic safety, public health, environmental care
Facts are available in both Hindi and English
Users can view previous days' facts in a history section

file_operations.description: Create daily fact component displaying one civic fact per day with simple language. Support Hindi and English. Include date display.
Define collection of civic facts about waste management, traffic safety, public health, and environmental care in both Hindi and English. Use simple, accessible language.
Create component displaying archive of previous daily facts with dates for user browsing.
Create utility functions to select daily fact based on current date using deterministic rotation.

requirements.summary: Create daily moral story feature with positive civic messages
acceptanceCriteria: A new short moral story is available each day
Stories are 200-400 words in length with clear moral lessons
Stories emphasize civic values, community responsibility, and positive behavior
Stories use simple, engaging language suitable for all ages
Stories are available in both Hindi and English
Story archive allows users to read previous stories

file_operations.description: Create daily moral story component displaying one short story per day (200-400 words) with civic lessons. Support Hindi and English. Include date and moral lesson summary.

Define collection of short moral stories about civic responsibility, cleanliness, and good citizenship in both Hindi and English. Each story includes title, content, and moral lesson. Use simple, engaging language.
Create component displaying archive of previous daily stories with dates and titles for browsing.
Create utility functions to select daily story based on current date using deterministic rotation.

requirements.summary: Implement motivational video section with age-appropriate content
acceptanceCriteria: Video section is accessible from main navigation
Videos feature motivational content about civic responsibility and community improvement
Video titles and descriptions display in user's selected language
Content is appropriate for adult audiences
Videos are organized by category or theme
Video player works smoothly on mobile devices

file_operations.description: Create motivational videos section component displaying curated video content about civic responsibility. Organize by categories. Show titles and descriptions in selected language. Use HTML5 video player for mobile compatibility.
Define collection of motivational video metadata including titles, descriptions (Hindi and English), video URLs, categories, and adult-appropriate content tags.

requirements.summary: Create tobacco spit-free public report section with awareness messaging
acceptanceCriteria: Dedicated section for reporting tobacco spit violations with simplified interface
Section displays educational awareness message about health risks and public cleanliness
Awareness content uses simple, impactful language
Report submission follows same process as other civic issues
Statistics on tobacco spit reports are displayed to show community impact
Content is available in both Hindi and English

file_operations.description: Create dedicated tobacco spit reporting section with awareness banner, educational content about health risks, simplified report form, and statistics display. Reference generated icon image: frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-tobacco.dim_128x128.png. Support Hindi and English content.
Define tobacco awareness content including health risks, cleanliness impacts, and community messages in both Hindi and English. Use simple, impactful language.

Create main app layout component with mobile-first navigation, header with logo (frontend/public/assets/generated/civicguard-logo.dim_256x256.png), footer, and responsive structure. Apply dark theme styling consistently.
Create mobile navigation component with hamburger menu, drawer panel, and touch-optimized navigation links for key features.
Create header component with CivicGuard logo (frontend/public/assets/generated/civicguard-logo.dim_256x256.png), navigation, language toggle, and login button. Use dark theme styling.
Create reusable icon button component optimized for touch interactions with proper sizing and dark theme styling.
